title: Princess Maker: Yumemiru Yousei (Demo)
native_title: プリンセス・メーカー ～ゆめみる妖精～
overview:
She Has Come to Your Home! A Fairy's Daughter

- An adorable daughter entrusted to you by a fairy. Will she work hard to become a princess? Or...

A tiny fairy dreams of becoming a human princess, and the fairy queen grants her a human life so she can chase that wish. She comes to live with you, and you have eight years to raise her into a young woman.

Princess Maker: Yumemiru Yousei is a raising simulation. Choose your own profession at the start, then plan your daughter's schedule day by day, take her shopping, change her outfits, talk with her and check her status as she grows. Seasonal events and festivals come and go, and the choices you make decide which of many futures she reaches.

This disc is a demo version of the game.
